summary: Audit logs delayed >30 minutes (eu-west) for Vertex Legaltech (Enterprise) — confirm pipeline backlog + customer mitigation
description:
## Issue summary
Vertex Legaltech reports audit log records are arriving >30 minutes late in eu-west. Customer is using audit logs for compliance monitoring + SIEM ingestion; late delivery causes their ingestion job to flag missing events and triggers internal alerts.

## Impact
- Customer-facing: perceived missing audit events for ~30–60 minutes, later backfilled.
- Business/compliance: enterprise account; security team expects near-real-time visibility and is escalating internally.

## Customer-reported symptoms
- "Audit log export shows gaps for the last ~45 minutes; older records appear eventually."
- Ingestion job errors when expected window is empty; retries increase.

## Environment
- Tier: Enterprise
- Region: eu-west
- Product area: Audit logs delivery pipeline

## What we need to confirm
A) Redwood audit log delivery pipeline backlog (queue/consumer lag), vs
B) customer-side ingestion assumptions (polling window too tight, lack of overlap/dedupe), vs
C) downstream sink throttling.

## Initial investigation (Support)
- Requested:
  - exact time range of observed lag
  - example event timestamp vs delivery timestamp
  - destination type (pull job cadence + lookback window)
- Checked internal metrics (Grafana → Audit Logs → Pipeline Health):
  - `auditlog_delivery_lag_seconds` elevated (p95 peaked ~2,700s) in eu-west
  - queue depth increasing then draining in sawtooth pattern
  - delivery error rate low (symptom consistent with backlog/consumer lag vs drops)

## Customer-safe mitigation (approved)
- Recommend widening polling/export window with overlap + dedupe by event ID.
  - Suggested: run every 5 minutes, pull last 60 minutes with overlap; dedupe.
- Recommend exponential backoff + jitter for retries.
- Avoid aggressive backfill loops that hammer small time slices.

## Escalation / workstream
- Paged SRE to confirm backlog and ETA to drain.
- Follow-up engineering work: add first-class audit log lag metric + alert thresholds aligned to enterprise expectations (ENG-4824).

resolution: SRE confirmed audit log delivery pipeline backlog in eu-west; backlog drained and delivery latency returned to baseline by 2026-02-11. Support provided temporary mitigation (widen export/polling window with overlap + dedupe; retries with backoff). Follow-up engineering work opened to add first-class lag metrics/alerts and dashboards aligned to enterprise expectations (ENG-4824; observability-pack/pr-711).
